title: RedactionStatus
description: Live progress record for the async 段B PaddleOCR redaction job. Written/updated by scripts/run_redaction_job.py as it processes redaction_manifest.json. Idempotent and retryable: files already 'done' are skipped on re-run. The QA gate is authoritative for the delete-original safety carve-out — an original (upload + mirror copy) may be deleted ONLY when its file entry has qa_passed=true.

patient_dir.description: Absolute path to <patient_dir> (e.g. /abs/PT-XXXX). Must match the patient_dir of the manifest that drove this run.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent write to this status file.

summary.description: Roll-up counters across files[]. total = manifest file count; pending + done + failed + blocked SHOULD equal total.

pending.description: Not yet attempted (or queued for retry).

failed.description: QA gate failed; original retained for manual review.

blocked.description: Cannot run — e.g. PaddleOCR venv (~/.venvs/mtb-ocr) missing.

files.description: One entry per manifest file, joined by id.

redacted_path.description: Bucket-relative path to the redacted image that replaced the bucket copy. Present when status='done'.

qa_passed.description: QA gate result: true only when the second PaddleOCR pass confirms no residual recognizable PII token in the masked regions. Authoritative precondition for original deletion.

original_deleted.description: true once both the upload original and the pre-redaction mirror copy have been deleted (mirror keeps only the redacted version). May be true ONLY when qa_passed=true.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation for status='failed' or 'blocked', e.g. 'QA 残留 PII: 右上角姓名未框中' or 'PaddleOCR venv ~/.venvs/mtb-ocr 缺失'.
